item.title: Tokyo Solo Travel Guide: The Best City in the World to Explore Alone
item.description: Tokyo is the world’s greatest city for solo travel. The combination of absolute safety (Tokyo consistently ranks in the top 3 safest cities globally), excellent single-serving dining culture, efficient public transport, and a population that minds its own business while being quietly helpful when asked makes it genuinely perfect for independent exploration. This guide covers everything a solo traveller needs to know. 🏨 Where to Stay Capsule Hotels — The Quintessential Solo Experience Capsule hotels are a Japanese invention designed specifically for single travellers — a sleeping pod (roughly 2m × 1m × 1m) with a curtain or sliding door, bedside light, power outlet, and often a TV, set in a building with shared bathrooms, lounges, saunas, and often excellent restaurant facilities.
